item.title: Police warn Lapeer residents after 40+ sharp objects found hidden in city parks
item.description: Police in Lapeer are warning residents to watch their step after receiving reports that someone has been hiding sharp objects around two city parks.

item.title: Oakland County GOP headquarters closes after receiving suspicious envelope
item.description: Police in Bloomfield Township responded to the Oakland County Republican Party headquarters on Friday after it was reported that the group received an envelope with an unknown white powder inside.

item.title: Supreme Court tariff ruling creates uncertainty for Michigan businesses
item.description: A Birmingham apparel business owner is grappling with uncertainty after the Supreme Court struck down most of President Trump's tariffs, only to see him impose a new 10% global tariff in response.
